III (1858), archive.org lettresinstructi03richuoft OCR (djvu text) re-read 19 Nov 2026 for the headings and dates of CXLVI-CLXVII; the nine letters themselves as transcribed and counted in PR #813 (open), targets/richelieu/texts/fr3828_avenel_figures.txt.
seen.extent: Nine Richelieu letters of 21 Mar - 25 May 1629 (Rance and the Queen Mother): CXIX, CXXXV, CXLVI, CXLVII, CLIII, CLIV, CLV, CLVIII, CLXVII, printed with the cipher figures in place and the editor's decipherment of each run in a footnote.
seen.cipher: Runs of two-digit figures and code numbers in clear French text, with Avenel's footnote glosses (he says he recomposed the cipher from Affaires etrangeres documents, note to CXXXV). By PR #813's own account (not re-run here): the key recovered for fr. 3829 ff. 87, 89, without Avenel's text, reproduces his glosses, 368 of 374 cipher words sure; one pre-registered test on CLIV and CLV (333 figures held out): 0.940 against 0.456 for the best of 200 shuffled tables.

1577.closed: Existing (Avenel 1858), verified with the key. The eight letters of this lead (fr. 3828 nos. 8, 10, 17, 18, 19, 21, 26; fr. 3835 no. 15) are printed in Avenel t. III: CXLVI (fol. 24), CXLVII (fol. 30), CLIII (fol. 48), CLIV (fol. 51), CLV (fol. 54), CLVIII (fol. 59, Avenel's heading 'fol. 69'), CLXVII (fol. 73, Avenel's heading 'fol. 78'), CXIX (fr. 3835 no. 15, fol. 46), each with the figures and his decipherment in footnotes; PR #813 (open) checks them with the key for fr. 3829 ff. 87, 89 (four small differences with his glosses). Nothing is left to read; not a catalogue candidate. Folio numbers: Avenel's headings for CLVIII and CLXVII read 'fol. 69' and 'fol. 78' in the archive.org OCR (and lead 2744 copied them); PR #813 gives fr. 3828 no. 21 as fol. 59 and no. 26 as fol. 73. Which is right (a printed slip, an older foliation or the PR's reading) was not settled here without the BnF volume; fol. 59 is used below as the corrected value of the PR, 'fol. 69' kept as Avenel's printed heading.
1577.key_check: Key for fr. 3829 ff. 87, 89 held in targets/richelieu; applied to all nine letters in PR #813 (open), pre-registered test passed (0.940 against 0.456), by that PR's own account.
